answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network couples cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: registering the $n$-th alias requires burning stake proportional to $O(n^2)$. An attacker attempting to wander across identity boundaries must destroy massive capital to conquer each digital knoll. Every agent deposits a verifiable quartz key commitment; because burn costs scale superlinearly, running multiple deceptive nodes rapidly becomes economically ruinous.
